roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines your passion for education with your expertise in infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and staff competency. You will play a crucial part in fostering a safe and knowledgeable environment for both residents and staff. We are actively seeking a professional to start soon.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing staff education programs, conducting infection surveillance, and ensuring compliance with all relevant health regulations. Your contributions will directly impact the quality of care and the overall well-being of our community. This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or infection control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection prevention
salaryOrBonusInfo: This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.
